name: oli

scripts.check: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/native-capture.js && node --check server/index.js && node --check server/audio.js && node --check server/config.js && node --check server/db.js && node --check server/logger.js && node --check server/rag.js && node --check server/knowledge.js && node --check server/obsidian.js && node --check server/vector.js && node --check server/brain.js && node --check server/agents.js && node --check server/skills.js && node --check server/orchestration.js && node --check server/ai/index.js && node --check server/ai/utils.js && node --check server/ai/gemini.js && node --check server/ai/local.js && node --check server/ai/nvidia.js && node --check server/ai/whisper.js && node --check renderer/audio-capture.js && node --check mcp/server.js && bash -n scripts/setup-local-llm.sh && bash -n scripts/run-local-chat.sh && bash -n scripts/bootstrap-sovereign.sh

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Oli uses your microphone to transcribe your side of the conversation.
